legend.0: No operations use expired keys after refresh failure.
legend.1: Expired keys may be used only within a fixed deadline that failures cannot extend.
legend.2: Failures can repeatedly extend expired-key use without a fixed absolute deadline.

legend.0: Affected operations stop until a successful fetch; backoff may delay recovery further.
legend.1: Affected operations can continue for a fixed bounded grace, then stop.
legend.2: Affected operations can continue across prolonged failures in at least one response class by repeatedly reusing retained keys.

legend.0: Rejects all expired-key use after refresh failures, differing on the core reference reuse behavior.
legend.1: Allows some failed-refresh reuse but changes deadlines or error classes compared to reference.
legend.2: Matches supplied reference freshness ordering and response-dependent reuse.

legend.0: Only successful entries persist; failed calls reject without separate persistent failure/grace state.
legend.1: Freshness on failure or an additional retry timestamp requires dedicated failure-state tests.
legend.2: Tracks successful expiry separately from a nonrenewable grace deadline and classifies failures; requires deadline and failure-class interaction tests.
